procedure: Clamp the bar magnet horizontally on the stand.
Touch the head of an iron nail to one end of the magnet. Touch another iron nail to the lower end of the first one and observe whether it sticks.
Go on hanging iron nails one by one to make a chain until no more nails stay attached to the chain.
Try to hang steel nails at the other end of the bar magnet to form a similar chain.
Remove the chain of iron nails by pulling the topmost nail. Observe whether the chain collapses.
Remove the chain of steel nails in the same way. Observe whether it collapses.
aim: To compare the temporary magnetism induced in iron nails with the permanent magnetism induced in steel nails.

viva.question: What happens when an iron nail touches a bar magnet?
viva.answer: It is attracted and becomes temporarily magnetised.

viva.question: Why can one iron nail hold another?
viva.answer: The first nail becomes a temporary magnet by induction.

viva.question: What happens to the chain of iron nails when the top nail is removed?
What happens to the chain of steel nails when the top nail is removed?
viva.answer: The nails remain attached to each other for some time.

viva.question: Which material shows temporary induced magnetism in this activity?
Which material retains magnetism for longer?

rows: Nails remain attached for some time

diagram: Draw a bar magnet clamped horizontally on a stand, labelled S at the left end and N at the right end, with chains of nails hanging from both ends; label the bar magnet, stand, clamp, iron-nail chain, and steel-nail chain.
title: Temporary and permanent magnetism in nails
precautions: Clamp the bar magnet firmly in a horizontal position.
Touch each nail gently to the magnet and avoid disturbing the stand.
Use separate chains for iron and steel nails.
Pull the topmost nail carefully when removing each chain.
result: The iron-nail chain collapses immediately, showing that the induced magnetism in iron is temporary. The steel nails remain attached for some time, showing that steel retains induced magnetism longer.
